tldr: 台股週五重挫 1,195.97 點（2.67%）收 43,654.84 點，國際科技股走弱加上外資大賣重擊指數。
台積電上調 2026 年資本支出至 600–640 億美元，並傳自 2027 年調漲代工價最高 10%，牽動 AI 晶片供應鏈。
監理端擴大財管開放：土銀成第 25 家取得高資產執照的銀行，金管會同步備妥「金融大回饋」指引。
國際上，特斯拉因獲利不如預期重挫約 14%，英特爾則因營收創高勁揚，布蘭特原油因中東緊張突破每桶 100 美元。
中經院上修台灣 2026 年 GDP 至 10.35%，但 CPI 預測回升至 2% 警戒線之上。

items.title_zh: 台股週五殺盤重挫近 1,200 點
items.title_en: TAIEX plunges nearly 1,200 points as Friday selloff deepens
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週五終場大跌 1,195.97 點、跌幅 2.67%，收 43,654.84 點，成交量放大至 7,924 億元。權值王台積電跌 55 元至 2,350 元。盤面跟隨隔夜美股與亞洲科技股回檔，延續近期高波動格局，市場對 AI 高估值的疑慮再度升溫。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index tumbled 1,195.97 points, or 2.67%, to close at 43,654.84 on Friday, with turnover swelling to NT$792.4bn. Chip bellwether TSMC fell NT$55 to NT$2,350 as the market tracked overnight declines on Wall Street and across Asian tech names, extending a volatile stretch that has questioned lofty AI valuations.

items.title_zh: 外資連賣狂砍台股，台幣貶破 32 元
items.title_en: Foreign investors dump Taiwan shares, TWD breaches 32
items.summary_zh: 外資三個交易日合計賣超近 2,000 億元，本月稍早一度拖累指數失守 47,000 點，並帶動新台幣貶破 32 元大關。南亞科、華邦電、力成等記憶體族群成為賣壓重災區，反映資金自高本益比科技股大舉撤離。
items.summary_en: Overseas funds sold a net of nearly NT$200bn over three sessions, dragging the index below the 47,000 mark earlier in the month and pushing the Taiwan dollar past the 32-per-USD level. Memory names including Nanya Tech, Winbond and Powertech were among the hardest hit, reflecting a broad rotation out of high-valuation technology plays.

items.title_zh: 台積電上調 2026 資本支出至 600–640 億美元
items.title_en: TSMC raises 2026 capex to US$60–64bn on AI demand
items.summary_zh: 台積電法說會將全年資本支出上修至 600–640 億美元，並加碼 1,000 億美元投資亞利桑那，反映 AI 與高效能運算需求強勁。約 70–80% 資金投入先進製程，2 奈米放量成為成長亮點，CoWoS 先進封裝產能也持續擴充。
items.summary_en: At its Q2 earnings call, TSMC lifted its full-year capital-spending budget to US$60–64bn and pledged an additional US$100bn for Arizona, citing insatiable demand for AI and high-performance computing. About 70–80% of spending targets advanced nodes, with 2nm ramping as a key growth driver and CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity continuing to expand.

items.title_zh: 台積電傳 2027 年起代工漲價最高 10%
items.title_en: TSMC reportedly to raise foundry prices up to 10% from 2027
items.summary_zh: 據《日經亞洲》報導，台積電計畫自 2027 年起調漲晶圓代工價格，涵蓋先進與成熟製程，依客戶與產品調幅 5–10%。漲價主因反映材料、設備及海外建廠成本攀升；若客戶追加超出預估的 HPC 訂單，恐再加收 10–15% 溢價。
items.summary_en: According to Nikkei Asia, TSMC plans to lift wafer-foundry pricing across both advanced and mature nodes from 2027, with increases of 5–10% depending on customer and product. The hike reflects rising costs for materials, equipment and overseas fabs; customers adding HPC orders beyond forecast may face a further 10–15% premium.

items.title_zh: 金管會 7 月將公布「金融大回饋」指引
items.title_en: FSC to publish "financial give-back" guideline in July
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆表示，將於 7 月發布「金融大回饋」指引，引導金融業在追求獲利成長之餘兼顧社會責任與社會投資。此舉顯示監理端對獲利創高的金融機構回饋社會的期待升高，期望盈餘能轉化為更廣泛的公共效益。
items.summary_en: FSC Chairman Peng Jin-long said the regulator would release a "financial give-back" guideline in July, aiming to steer banks and insurers toward balancing profit growth with social responsibility and social investment. The move signals rising supervisory expectations that record-earning financial institutions channel gains into broader public benefit.

items.title_zh: 土銀取得財管 2.0 執照，累計 25 家銀行獲准
items.title_en: Land Bank wins high-asset wealth licence, 25th bank approved
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意台灣土地銀行辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品與服務，成為第 25 家取得「財管 2.0」執照的銀行。土銀原則上有望於年底前開辦，國銀爭搶高資產客群的競爭態勢進一步升溫。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved Land Bank to offer financial products and services for high-net-worth clients under the "Wealth Management 2.0" framework, bringing the total number of licensed banks to 25. Land Bank is expected to launch the business by year-end, intensifying competition among domestic banks for affluent clients.

items.title_zh: 高資產財管規模衝 2.4 兆元，客戶數創新高
items.title_en: High-asset AUM hits NT$2.4tn as client base sets record
items.summary_zh: 截至 3 月底，銀行高資產財管管理規模達 2.4 兆元、年增 55%，符合資格客戶數攀升至 23,206 人、年增 72%，雙創新高。資產配置仍以存款約 42% 為最大宗，其次為基金 17%、債券 14.5%、保險 12% 與境外結構型商品約 8%。
items.summary_en: Assets managed under banks' high-net-worth wealth business reached NT$2.4tn as of end-March, up 55% year-on-year, while the number of qualifying clients climbed to a record 23,206, up 72%. Deposits remain the largest allocation at about 42%, followed by funds (17%), bonds (14.5%), insurance (12%) and offshore structured products (8%).

items.title_zh: 高股息 ETF 領跑今年績效榜
items.title_en: High-dividend ETFs dominate this year's performance table
items.summary_zh: 在股市震盪之際，高股息 ETF 持續吸引散戶資金湧入，今年績效前十名涵蓋多檔熱門台股掛牌產品。財管信託平台亦新增多檔 ETF，包括標普 500、美國科技巨頭與全球收益債券基金等，為在波動中追求收益的投資人擴大配置選擇。
items.summary_en: Amid choppy equity markets, high-dividend ETFs have drawn heavy retail inflows, with the year's top-ten performers ranging across popular Taiwan-listed products. The wealth-management channel has also added multiple new ETFs — including S&P 500, US mega-cap tech and global income bond funds — broadening options for yield-seeking investors navigating volatility.

items.title_zh: 財政部釐清遺留股票「應收股利」遺產稅申報
items.title_en: Ministry of Finance clarifies estate-tax treatment of inherited dividends
items.summary_zh: 財政部發布指引，說明被繼承人遺留股票所附「應收股利」於遺產稅之申報方式，協助繼承人正確申報未分配的股利權益。此舉旨在減少申報爭議，因應高資產遺產多以集中持股形式傳承的趨勢。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance issued guidance on how "receivable dividends" attached to shares left by a deceased person should be reported for estate-tax purposes, helping heirs correctly declare undistributed dividend rights. The clarification aims to reduce filing disputes as more affluent estates pass down concentrated equity holdings.

items.title_zh: 2026 遺產稅、贈與稅免稅額維持
items.title_en: 2026 estate and gift-tax allowances held steady
items.summary_zh: 2026 年遺產稅與贈與稅免稅額維持不變，贈與稅每年免稅額仍為 244 萬元，課稅級距則隨物價微幅調整。另外，台灣持續依 CRS 進行金融帳戶資訊自動交換，跨境申報義務仍是高資產家庭關注重點。
items.summary_en: For 2026, the estate-tax and gift-tax exemption thresholds remain unchanged, with the annual gift-tax allowance staying at NT$2.44m while tax brackets see minor inflation adjustments. Meanwhile Taiwan continues automatic exchange of financial-account information under the CRS framework, keeping cross-border reporting obligations in focus for high-net-worth families.
items.source_name: 財政部稅務用途資訊交換專區

items.title_zh: 中經院上修 2026 GDP 至 10.35%，CPI 重回 2% 之上
items.title_en: CIER raises 2026 GDP forecast to 10.35%, CPI back above 2%
items.summary_zh: 中華經濟研究院將 2026 年經濟成長率上修至 10.35%，高於主計總處 9.64% 預測，主因出口、投資與內需同步走強。中經院同時將全年 CPI 預測上修至 2.02%，使通膨重回 2% 警戒線之上，增添央行政策拿捏的難度。
items.summary_en: The Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research lifted its 2026 growth forecast to 10.35%, above the official 9.64% projection, citing simultaneous strength in exports, investment and domestic demand. It also nudged its full-year CPI estimate up to 2.02%, pushing inflation back above the 2% alert line and complicating the central bank's policy calculus.

items.title_zh: 國泰 7 月信心調查：看好成長、憂心通膨並存
items.title_en: Public confidence survey: strong growth hopes but inflation worries
items.summary_zh: 國泰金控 7 月「國民經濟信心調查」顯示，約 6 成民眾預期 2026 年 GDP 成長逾 9%，約 7 成憂心通膨率高於 2%。此一落差凸顯台灣在 AI 帶動出口榮景下，民眾仍對生活成本上升保持戒心。
items.summary_en: Cathay Financial's July economic-confidence survey found about 60% of respondents expect 2026 GDP growth to exceed 9%, while roughly 70% worry inflation will run above 2%. The split underscores an economy enjoying an AI-driven export boom even as households remain wary of rising living costs.

items.title_zh: 美股兩樣情：道瓊創高、那指走弱
items.title_en: US markets split: Dow hits record, Nasdaq slides
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，美股走勢分歧，費城半導體指數連三日大漲後回吐 5.7%，道瓊指數卻再創歷史新高；SpaceX 市值傳超越亞馬遜，凸顯在 AI 交易前景不明下，資金持續在科技巨頭之間輪動。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media reported that Wall Street diverged sharply, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index giving back 5.7% after a three-day rally while the Dow set a fresh record high. SpaceX's valuation was reported to have surpassed Amazon's, highlighting how capital keeps rotating between mega-cap tech winners and losers amid an uncertain AI trade.

items.title_zh: 全球科技股回檔＋油價飆漲衝擊市場
items.title_en: Global tech rout and oil spike rattle sentiment
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體指出，美股週中重挫，道指跌 0.97%、標普跌 1.21%、那指跌 2.15%，特斯拉暴跌逾 14%，布蘭特原油因中東緊張突破每桶 100 美元。AI 估值疑慮與能源成本飆升雙重衝擊，壓抑亞洲市場風險偏好。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese outlets flagged that US indices tumbled mid-week — the Dow off 0.97%, S&P 500 down 1.21% and Nasdaq off 2.15% — as Tesla plunged more than 14% and Brent crude vaulted above US$100 a barrel on Middle East tensions. The twin shocks of AI-valuation jitters and surging energy costs weighed on risk appetite across Asian markets.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉獲利不如預期，股價重挫約 14%（2026-07-23）
items.title_en: Tesla shares sink ~14% as profit misses despite record revenue (2026-07-23)
items.summary_zh: 特斯拉第二季營收 282.4 億美元優於預期，但調整後每股盈餘 0.33 美元遠低於市場預估的 0.49 美元。汽車毛利率降至 16.3%，資本支出年增 142% 使自由現金流轉負。股價單日暴跌約 14.5%、市值蒸發約 1,400 億美元，投資人質疑 Robotaxi 與 Optimus 進度。
items.summary_en: Tesla reported Q2 revenue of US$28.24bn, beating estimates, but adjusted EPS of US$0.33 fell well short of the US$0.49 consensus. Automotive gross margin slid to 16.3% and free cash flow turned negative on a 142% jump in capex. Shares tumbled about 14.5%, wiping out roughly US$140bn in value as investors questioned the pace toward robotaxi and Optimus.

items.title_zh: 英特爾營收年增 25% 勁揚，卻認列 110 億美元虧損（2026-07-23）
items.title_en: Intel jumps on 25% revenue growth, but books US$11bn loss (2026-07-23)
items.summary_zh: 英特爾第二季營收 161 億美元、年增 25%，創逾 15 年最快增速，調整後每股盈餘 0.42 美元為預估兩倍，AI 相關業務成長逾 70%。盤後股價一度大漲 13%；惟公司因 CHIPS 法案託管股份評價認列 110 億美元淨虧損。
items.summary_en: Intel posted Q2 revenue of US$16.1bn, up 25% year-on-year and its fastest growth in over 15 years, with adjusted EPS of US$0.42 doubling estimates as AI-related businesses grew more than 70%. Shares leapt as much as 13% after hours, though the company recorded an US$11bn net loss tied to a mark-to-market charge on CHIPS Act escrow shares.

items.title_zh: 布蘭特原油突破 100 美元，中東緊張升溫（2026-07-23）
items.title_en: Brent crude tops US$100 as Middle East tensions escalate (2026-07-23)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價飆破每桶 100 美元，布蘭特結算約 100.68 美元、西德州約 92.36 美元，主因美伊衝突再起及沙烏地外海油輪傳遭襲擊。本月油價上漲約 30%、創 5 月以來新高，市場憂心荷姆茲海峽運輸受阻恐使能源成本居高不下。
items.summary_en: Oil prices surged past US$100 a barrel — Brent settling near US$100.68 and WTI around US$92.36 — after renewed US-Iran hostilities and reported strikes on tankers near Saudi Arabia. Crude has climbed roughly 30% this month, its highest since May, stoking fears that disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz could keep energy costs elevated for months.

items.title_zh: 美股收震盪一週，那指因資本支出疑慮走弱（2026-07-24）
items.title_en: Wall Street closes a volatile week; Nasdaq slips on capex fears (2026-07-24)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五在動盪一週後漲跌互見，那斯達克與羅素 2000 收黑，反映投資人憂心 AI 相關資本支出過高；道瓊與標普 500 則因油價盤中回落而收復部分失土。本週市場受財報、油價飆升與聯準會政策預期反覆牽動，下週 Fed 會議成焦點。
items.summary_en: US stocks ended a turbulent week mixed on Friday, with the Nasdaq and Russell 2000 closing lower as investors fretted over heavy AI-related capital spending, while the Dow and S&P 500 clawed back earlier losses as oil retreated intraday. The session capped a week whipsawed by earnings, an oil spike and shifting Fed-policy expectations ahead of next week's meeting.
